answer: Decay is the only thing here that scales. Standing drops every epoch an identity does not submit, one submission per identity per epoch, and each claim is rechecked by a party with nothing to gain, so the pulse of 1000 parked names flattens within a few closes. Skeptical read: decay punishes parking, not faking, and a funded operator can fake slowly. Cost: 1000 real tasks per epoch to hold 1000 names, or a slow meadow of velvet that fades to nothing.
